"Left stick - cursor
Right stick - camera
A / B - LMB / RMB (can be held)
X - terrain Y - pause
LB / RB - scale / list scroll
LT - precise guidance RT - Shift
D-pad ↑ / ↓ - speed
D-pad ← / → - map rotation
L3 - scale 100% R3 - lock (F1)
Start - menu Select / Back - layout"

"Hold Select for combinations:
↑ → ↓ ← - squads 1-4
A B X Y - squads 5-8 LB - squad 9
Add RT - record squad
Add LT - map points 1-9
LT + RT - record map point
RB - radar colors L3 - book commands
R3 - keyboard Start - settings

The cursor disappears after 30 seconds of inactivity.
Close: A, B, Start or Select."
"Arrangement editor: select and drag an element, size with two fingers"
"Select an item. Drag; size - pinch or slider."
"Game field: touch, drag selection, two fingers for map"

"

Clerk's Book: Hold to open the list, then press a command or swipe to select it and release. Tapping the book again hides the list. Assignments are changed through the button catalog.

Side zones are empty by default. Assign commands to the left or right zone: tap opens a vertical list, tap again on the same zone hides it. Hold for about a third of a second and move your finger towards the command, release to execute.

The layout editor shows a pause: select and drag a button or zone, change the size with two fingers, a slider or a corner. “Buttons” specifies the placement of commands on the screen, in the book and in the side areas. “Zone Actions” switches the list or individual tap and hold assignments. Changes are applied only through “Save”; “Cancel” or Android “Back” returns the previous layout."

"On the map, tap selects troops or gives orders, sliding your finger moves the camera. To frame troops or draw a wall, hold your finger for about a third of a second, then drag. Holding cancels the construction or selection.

Two fingers: shift - camera, pinch or spread - smooth zoom around the middle of the gesture. Tapping on the percentage above the radar returns 100%, turning it about a quarter of a turn - rotate the map (C / X), short tap - cancel. Holding the radar switches the terrain, a short tap with two fingers above it - the “friends / foes” coloring.

In menus and windows, tap presses a button or opens the keyboard for a text field; dragging pulls sliders and lists. Holding down the scribe's book opens a vertical list of commands. By default, it has control settings and a pause menu. Android "Back" opens the game menu (Esc).

Swiping across the building panel switches available sections. The selected building is highlighted, and its name and cost are shown next to it. The magnifying glass when selecting a location is turned off by default; its size and proximity can be changed in the settings.

Squad and Point buttons are added via the button catalog in the layout editor. Groups: tap on selected troops - record, hold - call; calling again centers the camera. Dots: tap - go, hold - record the current view. The center or area behind the circle deselects.

Game speed, sound, scrolling, interface size, clear text, touchpad and button layout are available in the settings. “Full Screen” selects the aspect ratio of the device. The “⇄” button opens the transition between games and the launcher."

"On the map: tap - choice or order, double tap - unit of the same type. Sliding your finger moves the camera; for a frame, first hold your finger down for about a third of a second, then pull.

Holding on the map cancels a highlight, structure, or ability; if there is nothing to cancel, it evens out the relief. Holding the radar also switches the terrain.

Two fingers move the camera and change the zoom. A two-finger twist of about a quarter turn rotates the card 90°. Short tap with two fingers - cancel; above the radar is the “friend/foe” coloring. Tapping on the scale value above the radar returns 100%.

In the menu, tap presses the button, holding shows the description; Sliders and lists can be dragged. Holding the scribe's book opens a vertical list of commands; in the editor, hold the pen to the left of the panel. The Arrangement button allows you to drag each button individually. Android "Back" opens the game menu.

Squad and Point buttons are added via the button catalog in the layout editor. Groups: tap on selected troops - record, hold - call; calling again centers the camera. Dots: tap - go, hold - record the current view. The center or area behind the circle deselects.

Swiping across the buildings panel scrolls through the available sections: left - next, right - previous; From a subsection, swiping in any direction opens the next section. The selected building is highlighted on its button.

Magnifying Glass: While your finger selects a location for a building, wall, demolition, or ability, a magnified portion of the map is shown nearby. A short tap puts it right away, without a magnifying glass.

Vibration marks the zoom setting to 100%, changing the section of buildings, holding, rotating and selecting units and map points. Magnifying glass and vibration can be turned off in the settings.

Mouse and keyboard (USB or Bluetooth): with a mouse, the game works like on a PC - pointing, LMB and RMB, scrolling the camera at the edge of the screen. The match wheel changes scale around the cursor and scrolls through menus and lists. Dragging with the middle button moves the map, clicking with the middle button returns 100%. Keys - as in the original: Esc - menu, space - relief, +/− number pad - speed, X/C - rotation. Tapping the screen reactivates touch controls.

Touchpad - additional cursor mode. The touch is performed by LMB; A separate LMB button can be enabled in the control settings."

"Long press on a line to read the function description.

Parameters use prepared Android profile values. All functions are initially disabled.

Not available yet:
"
"Changes are applied when the game is restarted."
"This function conflicts with the one already enabled. Choose one of them."
"The AI will no longer demolish and rebuild its buildings continuously, when they can\'t be reached by a worker."
"Change the increase of army per attack wave"
"In vanilla each AI lord increases their army by 5 additional units for each main attack. You can adjust the amount here."
"Disable AI switching attack targets during a siege"

"AIs with the target choice set to gold or weakest were sometimes reevaluating who they would attack in the midst of a siege, running their troops across the whole map. With this fix, the AI will stick with their previously chosen target."
"Adjust AI limit for recruiting attack troops"

"The AI\'s number of main army units are capped at the size of their first attack plus this value (200 in vanilla). After reaching this limit, the AI stops recruiting troops and no longer sends out main attacks.\nNOTE: Very high values can cause the global unit limit to be reached in longer games, resulting in peasants being unable to spawn."

"In vanilla the AI only sends out a single soldier per wallpiece in an attack and the rest of the army wait until a wallsegment is free again if there are more troops than avaviable walltile. 
this option will allow the AI to send multiple Units per wallsegment to take them down faster and will also have units attack buildings and towers which were previously ignored.
Additionally the Ai will also send all its remaining attack troops to the enemy keep once the walls have been breached.
Adjust the percentage of troops attacking outside castle buildings before a breach happens below:"

"In vanilla, the AIs when constructing a building are only stocking up on wood to match the exact price of the building they are about to construct. This leaves no buffer for active weapon production consuming wood. To prevent this issue, 2 additional wood are stocked up by the AI in this case."
"Fixes a bug which stopped the AI from replacing missing troops on walls and towers, as long as defensive patrols were still around."
"AI\'s European archers light pitch the same way Arabian archers do, when defending against enemy units."
"AIs no longer stop assaulting enemy walls with their Laddermen if their own keep is enclosed."

"The AI lords put their production buildings to sleep, if they run out of a resources they depend on for their Industry. E.g. all bakers are put to sleep when Saladin runs out of flour. \nHowever, this often disregards goods still being processed or midst their delivery leading to a constant loss of goods.\nHere you can disable this sleep mode for the AI entirely."
"With this setting the AIs will replace tower ruins and slightly damaged walls. They will also overbuild gathering grounds of recruitment buildings if their main building went missing."

"Sets the recruitment interval of all AIs to the lowest value, recruiting as fast as the Vanilla Rat/Richard.\nNOTE: There is a more granular way to set individual recruitment speed for AIs AIC using the aiSwapper module."
"Set AIs initial time until they recruit according to the AIC parameters"

"The AI often doesn\'t restock goods even if it has the gold for it, leaving its production chains running dry. This option reduces the amount of time the AI waits for its stocks to be empty before restocking the necessary goods."
"Set ox tethers to a maximum of 10 per AI lord"

"Usually, the AI builds a new ox tether for every new quarry it constructs, even if it exceeds the usual limit of 10 ox tethers per lord. This can lead to a spam of ox tethers, reaching the housing limit for an AI lord causing no new peasants to spawn. With this setting you can disable the placement of that extra ox tether when a new quarry is built."
"Increase the siege engine limit of the AI"
"Usually the AI only builds up to three mangonels and ballistas on its towers. With this option this limit is increased to 5 per engine."

"Changes the apple orchard\'s build preview to the size it occupies after the farm is placed down. This saves some space when building apple orchards and makes it easier for the AI to find space to place them on oasisgrass."
"Reorders weapon icons in the the marketplace to be the same as in the armory. This includes the switching of pages in the market, as well as the display in the main category."
"Spawn siege engines in the center of their tent"

"In Vanilla the siegeengines are being spawned in the top right of their construction tent. This options places them in the middle of the tent instead\n(however, the tent itself is still not centered at the location designated in the AIV editor)."
"This option allows the player to continuously place siegeengines down, without the game automatically deselecting the engine after the tent has been placed."
"Adjust the fireproof period for buildings after extinguishment."
"The amount of time during which extinguished buildings cannot catch fire again. In vanilla the duration is 2000 gameticks, which equals 2 1/2 months."
"Bakers no longer disappear when they don\'t find flour at their targeted stockpile."

"Fixes the behaviour where fletchers would go back to their workplace after delivering the bow/crossbow at the armory, instead of going straight to the stockpile to grab wood for the next production cycle."
"Units climbing ladders retain their move command target"
"Units will keep remembering their original destination after climbing a ladder, instead of getting stuck on the ladders and just waiting on the walltile they climbed up onto."
"Reduces the length of the sent map name, to make map sending possible again."
"Fixes the bug where moat digging units would disappear while digging. \nNote: Units can still despwawn if you order them to move while standing on unwalkable terrain!"
"Deleting buildings with a fast auto clicker no longer deletes the building multiple times. This way you dont get more resources back from deleting than the game has intended."

"This option makes the trading post cost no resources to prevent the AI from getting stuck due to not having enough resources to build the marketplace. In multiplayer games, this prevents the need to restart entirely or demolish buildings for wood when a trading post is forgotten."

"Enable the change of the gamespeed as follows:
- From 10 to 90 in intervals of 5
- From 90 to 200 in intervals of 10
- From 200 to 1000 in intervals of 100
The new values are only available ingame via the +- keys, the slider in the ingame menu remains unchanged."
"Apothecary worker now doubles as a healer"

"The healer of the apothecary building now actively seeks out injured soldiers, siegeengines, civilians and animals to heal them. The nearest targets are treated first. With each healing animation about 1/3 of a spearman\'s health is recovered. The strolling through gardens and investigation of plague clouds is not replaced. \nOnly the strolling through the castle is skipped until no more wounded targets are in the area."

"In vanilla, it took 200 game ticks to check for new pathing being avaviable, often stopping units to move into the castle after destroying a gate or tower immediately.\nChange the calcualtion of availability to every 50 gameticks, allowing the units to \'realize\' new paths being avaviable more quickly."
"Move camera with WASD-Keys and enable quicksaves"

"The WASD-keys can be used to move the camera around as well as CTRL-S and CTRL-L for quicksaving and loading respectively.\nNote: Writing map descriptions and selecting the Armory with A become infeasabile with this option."
"With this option you will always see your unfinished planned moat even when deselecting the moat tool or not having any units selected."

"Removes the human player from the first slot, enabeling you to spectate games between up to 8 AIs without interferance. Savegames load properly in this mode but if a player was present he will not be controllable. Sometimes a bug appears in which random objects spawn all over the map. This is just visually and can be removed by saving the game, ending the mission and reloading the save file."
"Override the Set-up Identity menu adding new features"

"Adds Ranged and Melee unit selection to Set-up Identity menu for the normal game mode in skirmish games.\nNote: To further alter the starting troops, you can enable different starting troops in the startResources module."
"Swap this slots color with the first slot."

"Gates often kept AIs trapped and felt unresponsive in themselves shuttin down traffic for too long. They now automatically close later if enemies get into their detection range and open faster after the danger is gone. \nReduce the detection range from 200 to 140 and the gameticks to reopen the gates after no enemies are detected from 1200 to 100."
"When you use the arabian lord, your engineers now use the originally recorded arabian voicelines."
"Rotate the players keep towards the map center"

"Player keeps now get rotated similar to the way that AIs keeps rotate on a map, pointing their campfire outwards towards the map edge.\nNote: This won\'t rotate any other buildings, their entrances and gathering grounds will still point towards the south-west corner of the map."
"Remove the magic bar in Crusader Extreme"
"Removes magic icons from Stronghold Crusader Extreme."
"Increased armor for Arabic swordsmen against crossbow bolts"
"Arabic swordsmen now die after getting hit 6 times by crossbow bolts instead of only 3"
"Fire ballistae now auto target monks and tunnelers"
"Fire ballistas automatically fire at monks and tunnel diggers."
"Apple farmers can no longer be blocked while collecting apples from their farm by placing buildings at the top left side of their farm."
"Reset the pose of the lord after he stops moving or destroying a building into his upright posture. Usually it would get stuck bend down to the ground."
"Increased armor of laddermen against ranged units"
"- Laddermen die after 12 arrow hits instead of 5\n- Laddermen die after 5 crossbow or slinger hits instead of 2\n- Laddermen cost 20 gold instead of 4"
"Increased armor of spearmen against ranged units"
"- Spearmen only die after 5 arrow hits instead of 3\n- Spearmen barely survive one crossbowbolt, instead of getting killed in one shot"
"Spearmen run by default instead of walking."
"Makes spearmen run by default like slaves and macemen."
"Tanners will no longer return without a cow when another tanner took their targeted cow. They will now wait a bit and then select a different cow."
